whatThisPluginAdds.text: Capell Inertia connects public page resolution to Inertia responses through a registered client adapter.

surfaceOutcome.text: It adds no admin screen. When an Inertia theme is active, public pages use the configured root view, component name, and adapter.

developers.text: The adapter registry and typed Actions centralize page props, component resolution, and response rendering for Inertia themes.

teams.text: Teams can use React or Vue Inertia themes while keeping the normal Capell content workflow.
